meanings.en: a disguise that hides something by making it blend in with its surroundings
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers wore camouflage to blend into the forest.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler ormana karışmak için kamuflaj giydiler.

meanings.en: the act of deceiving someone by hiding or distorting the truth
meanings.exampleEn: Their relationship was ruined by years of deceit.
meanings.exampleTr: İlişkileri yıllarca süren aldatmalarla mahvoldu.

meanings.en: to free someone from illusion or false belief
meanings.exampleEn: The scandal served to disenchant many of his loyal supporters.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandal, sadık destekçilerinin çoğunun hayal kırıklığına uğramasına yol açtı.

meanings.en: difficult to control or discipline
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher struggled to calm the unruly class.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen söz dinlemeyen sınıfı yatıştırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: able to be sacrificed or used up because not essential
meanings.exampleEn: In war, soldiers are sometimes treated as expendable.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaşta askerler bazen gözden çıkarılabilir olarak görülür.

meanings.en: to move to a new place
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to relocate its headquarters to Berlin.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket genel merkezini Berlin'e taşımaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: the act of taking something away
meanings.exampleEn: The removal of the old furniture took all morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski mobilyaların kaldırılması bütün sabah sürdü.

meanings.en: the complete removal or destruction of something
meanings.exampleEn: The elimination of poverty remains a global goal.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoksulluğun ortadan kaldırılması küresel bir hedef olmaya devam ediyor.

meanings.en: not happy or satisfied with one's situation
meanings.exampleEn: The discontented workers threatened to go on strike.
meanings.exampleTr: Hoşnutsuz işçiler greve gitmekle tehdit etti.

meanings.en: a person who publicly objects to something
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of protesters gathered in the square.
meanings.exampleTr: Binlerce protestocu meydanda toplandı.

meanings.en: a person who remains faithful to a ruler, party, or cause
meanings.exampleEn: The loyalists refused to abandon their leader.
meanings.exampleTr: Sadık taraftarlar liderlerini terk etmeyi reddettiler.

meanings.en: famous and respected within a particular field
meanings.exampleEn: She is an eminent scientist known for her research.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırmalarıyla tanınan seçkin bir bilim insanıdır.

meanings.en: the act of giving a false or misleading account of something
meanings.exampleEn: The article was a complete misrepresentation of his views.
meanings.exampleTr: Makale, onun görüşlerinin tamamen çarpıtılmasıydı.

meanings.en: the bending or twisting of something out of its proper shape
meanings.exampleEn: The warping of the wooden door was caused by moisture.
meanings.exampleTr: Ahşap kapının eğrilmesine nem neden oldu.

meanings.en: to divert someone from a main subject or course of action
meanings.exampleEn: Don't let small details sidetrack you from the goal.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük ayrıntıların seni hedeften uzaklaştırmasına izin verme.

meanings.en: causing feelings of distress or unhappiness
meanings.exampleEn: The news about the accident was deeply upsetting.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazayla ilgili haber çok üzücüydü.

meanings.en: making someone feel worried or anxious
meanings.exampleEn: The film contains some disturbing scenes of violence.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, bazı rahatsız edici şiddet sahneleri içeriyor.

meanings.en: a longer alternative route taken to avoid a direct path
meanings.exampleEn: We had to take a detour because the road was closed.
meanings.exampleTr: Yol kapalı olduğu için dolambaçlı bir yoldan gitmek zorunda kaldık.

meanings.en: to direct something to a different place or purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The police had to redirect traffic away from the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis trafiği kazadan uzağa yönlendirmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to send something or someone along a different route
meanings.exampleEn: The airline had to reroute the flight due to the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Havayolu, fırtına nedeniyle uçuşun güzergahını değiştirmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: a structure built along the water where ships load and unload
meanings.exampleEn: The fishing boats were tied up along the wharf.
meanings.exampleTr: Balıkçı tekneleri rıhtım boyunca bağlanmıştı.

meanings.en: a structure extending into the water for boats or walking
meanings.exampleEn: We walked to the end of the pier to watch the sunset.
meanings.exampleTr: Gün batımını izlemek için iskelenin ucuna kadar yürüdük.

meanings.en: a donkey; (informal) a foolish person
meanings.exampleEn: He made an ass of himself at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partide kendini rezil etti (aptal durumuna düştü).

meanings.en: a person whose job is to stand at the entrance of a building
meanings.exampleEn: The doorman greeted us as we entered the hotel.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapı görevlisi otele girerken bizi selamladı.

meanings.en: a person employed to carry luggage or goods
meanings.exampleEn: The porter carried our bags up to the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Hamal çantalarımızı odaya kadar taşıdı.

meanings.en: a common bird often seen in towns and cities
meanings.exampleEn: A pigeon landed on the windowsill this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sabah pencere kenarına bir güvercin kondu.

meanings.en: in a way that has a strong or severe effect
meanings.exampleEn: Prices have risen drastically over the past year.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen yıl içinde fiyatlar büyük ölçüde yükseldi.

meanings.en: pieces of cloth hung to cover a window
meanings.exampleEn: She drew the curtains to block out the sunlight.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş ışığını engellemek için perdeleri çekti.

meanings.en: long, heavy curtains that hang over a window
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel room had thick velvet drapes.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel odasında kalın kadife perdeler vardı.

meanings.en: deeply or seriously thoughtful, often with a touch of sadness
meanings.exampleEn: She sat by the window in a pensive mood.
meanings.exampleTr: Pencerenin yanında düşünceli bir ruh hâliyle oturdu.

meanings.en: safe to drink
meanings.exampleEn: The campsite provides potable water for visitors.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamp alanı ziyaretçilere içilebilir su sağlıyor.

meanings.en: not safe or pleasant to drink
meanings.exampleEn: The water from the well was undrinkable.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuyudan çıkan su içilemezdi.

meanings.en: a person who gives up easily
meanings.exampleEn: He's no quitter; he never gives up on his goals.
meanings.exampleTr: O kolay pes eden biri değil; hedeflerinden asla vazgeçmez.

meanings.en: a period without rain, or a period of little success or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The team is going through a dry spell with no wins this month.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım bu ay hiç galibiyet alamadan durgun bir dönem geçiriyor.

meanings.en: the act of making a reproduction of something
meanings.exampleEn: Copying someone else's work is considered cheating.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkasının çalışmasını kopyalamak hile sayılır.

meanings.tr: çok küçük şey/kişi (artık genellikle uygunsuz sayılır)
meanings.en: something or someone extremely small (now often considered offensive)
meanings.exampleEn: The toy car was a tiny midget compared to the real one.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncak araba, gerçeğine kıyasla minicik bir şeydi.

meanings.en: a substance used to add or change color
meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses a natural colorant in its candy.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, şekerlerinde doğal bir renklendirici kullanıyor.

meanings.en: a shade or small amount of a color
meanings.exampleEn: The sky had a pink tint at sunrise.
meanings.exampleTr: Gün doğumunda gökyüzünün hafif pembe bir tonu vardı.

meanings.en: not moving or changing
meanings.exampleEn: Sales have remained static for the last three months.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışlar son üç aydır durağan kaldı.

meanings.tr: şiddetle, büyük bir hevesle, keskin biçimde
meanings.en: in an eager or intense way
meanings.exampleEn: She was keenly aware of the danger ahead.
meanings.exampleTr: Önündeki tehlikenin keskin biçimde farkındaydı.

meanings.en: in an unwilling or hesitant manner
meanings.exampleEn: He reluctantly agreed to help with the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeye yardım etmeyi isteksizce kabul etti.

meanings.en: money paid regularly to a worker for their work
meanings.exampleEn: The workers demanded higher wages.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler daha yüksek ücret talep etti.

meanings.en: the costs incurred in doing something
meanings.exampleEn: The company covers all travel expenses for employees.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, çalışanların tüm seyahat masraflarını karşılıyor.

meanings.en: extremely happy and excited
meanings.exampleEn: She was elated when she heard she had won the prize.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü kazandığını duyunca sevinçten uçtu.

meanings.en: an article expressing the writer's personal views
meanings.exampleEn: She wrote an opinion piece about climate change for the newspaper.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete için iklim değişikliği hakkında bir görüş yazısı yazdı.

meanings.en: a spoken or written set of remarks explaining or describing an event
meanings.exampleEn: He provided live commentary during the football match.
meanings.exampleTr: Futbol maçı sırasında canlı yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: having much knowledge gained through study
meanings.exampleEn: He is a learned professor of ancient history.
meanings.exampleTr: O, antik tarih konusunda bilgili bir profesördür.

meanings.en: having or showing extensive knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: The guide was very knowledgeable about local history.
meanings.exampleTr: Rehber yerel tarih konusunda çok bilgiliydi.

meanings.en: in a way that achieves results with little waste of effort or resources
meanings.exampleEn: The new system handles requests more efficiently.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni sistem istekleri daha verimli biçimde işliyor.

meanings.en: in a way that does not produce the desired effect
meanings.exampleEn: The medicine worked ineffectively against the infection.
meanings.exampleTr: İlaç enfeksiyona karşı etkisiz biçimde işledi.

meanings.en: the quality of not producing the intended result
meanings.exampleEn: The report highlighted the ineffectiveness of the policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, politikanın etkisizliğini vurguladı.

meanings.en: to choose someone or something in an election
meanings.exampleEn: Many young people voted for the new candidate.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok genç yeni adaya oy verdi.

meanings.en: by means of digital technology
meanings.exampleEn: The documents are now stored digitally.
meanings.exampleTr: Belgeler artık dijital olarak saklanıyor.

meanings.en: lacking grace, refinement, or good taste
meanings.exampleEn: His inelegant handwriting was hard to read.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun zarafetsiz el yazısını okumak zordu.

meanings.en: in a fashionable and elegant manner
meanings.exampleEn: She was stylishly dressed for the gala.
meanings.exampleTr: Galaya şık biçimde giyinmişti.

meanings.en: in an awkward or careless way
meanings.exampleEn: He clumsily knocked over the glass of water.
meanings.exampleTr: Su bardağını sakar bir biçimde devirdi.

meanings.tr: hak sahibi olan; hak iddia eden, ayrıcalıklı hisseden
meanings.en: having the right to something; believing one deserves special treatment
meanings.exampleEn: All employees are entitled to paid holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm çalışanlar ücretli izne hak sahibidir.

meanings.en: not qualified or allowed to do or have something
meanings.exampleEn: He was ineligible to vote because of his age.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşı nedeniyle oy vermeye uygun değildi.

meanings.en: the social group with the highest status and wealth
meanings.exampleEn: The novel portrays the lives of the upper class.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, üst sınıfın yaşamlarını betimliyor.

meanings.en: the ordinary people of a society regarded as a group
meanings.exampleEn: The leader promised reforms to benefit the masses.
meanings.exampleTr: Lider, halk kitlelerinin yararına reformlar sözü verdi.

meanings.en: the ability to express ideas fluently and clearly
meanings.exampleEn: Her articulacy made her a compelling public speaker.
meanings.exampleTr: Akıcı konuşma yeteneği onu etkileyici bir hatip yaptı.

meanings.en: the office of a consul who represents their country abroad
meanings.exampleEn: She applied for a visa at the Turkish consulate.
meanings.exampleTr: Türk konsolosluğunda vize başvurusunda bulundu.

meanings.en: a person employed by an organization
meanings.exampleEn: A staff member will assist you at the front desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir personel, ön masada size yardımcı olacaktır.

meanings.en: the physical or mental strength to sustain prolonged effort
meanings.exampleEn: Running a marathon requires great stamina.
meanings.exampleTr: Maraton koşmak büyük bir dayanıklılık gerektirir.

meanings.en: extreme tiredness from exertion or illness
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, she felt overwhelming fatigue.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşün ardından büyük bir yorgunluk hissetti.

meanings.en: a formal agreement to marry
meanings.exampleEn: Their betrothal was announced at a family dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Nişanları bir aile yemeğinde duyuruldu.

meanings.en: to register or enroll for something
meanings.exampleEn: You can sign up for the newsletter on our website.
meanings.exampleTr: Bültene web sitemizden kaydolabilirsiniz.

meanings.en: without eagerness or interest
meanings.exampleEn: He unenthusiastically agreed to attend the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıya katılmayı isteksizce kabul etti.

meanings.en: not harmful to the environment
meanings.exampleEn: They switched to eco-friendly packaging for their products.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürünleri için çevre dostu ambalaja geçtiler.

meanings.en: causing harmful contamination of the environment
meanings.exampleEn: The factory was fined for its polluting emissions.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, kirletici emisyonları nedeniyle para cezasına çarptırıldı.
